issues.description: In the template for Exercise 1 the attribute number_of_qubits_query_register is set to a float literal (0.0) and immediately used to construct a QuantumRegister. The solution uses an integer (2). The float in the template is a structural error that will cause a type issue when instantiating QuantumRegister and will confuse or block students running the starter code.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template's number_of_qubits_query_register from 0.0 to an integer (e.g. 2) so that QuantumRegister receives an integer size. For example: self.number_of_qubits_query_register = 2. This matches the solution and avoids type errors when constructing the register.
